explication: rustfmt is a Rust source formatter. The main workflow accepts files or stdin, loads formatting configuration, parses Rust into compiler AST structures, rewrites code to fit configured style, then emits formatted output or diffs for check mode. The README also documents `cargo fmt` as a project/workspace entry point and configurable style editions. Internal links are limited to relationships named in the source index or README; several implementation stages are represented at subsystem level because their source was not sampled.
